exec 2>/dev/null

P=$PWD
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$P/gate"; exec 9<> "$P/gate"
nap() { read -t "${1:-0.05}" -u 9 _junk; }
for n in alpha alphax xalpha beta longnamedprocess1234567890 py chr; do :; done
for n in alpha alphax xalpha beta longnamedprocess1234567890; do /usr/bin/ln -s /usr/bin/sleep "$P/g1$n"; done
for n in py chr; do /usr/bin/ln -s /usr/bin/python3 "$P/g1$n"; done
declare -A PID
PID[sh]=$$
wait_comm() { local tag=$1 want=$2 c i; for ((i=0;i<400;i++)); do c=; read -r c < "/proc/${PID[$tag]}/comm" 2>/dev/null; [[ $c == "${want:0:15}" ]] && return 0; nap 0.005; done; return 1; }
mk() { local tag=$1 name=$2; shift 2; "$P/$name" "${@:-60}" & PID[$tag]=$!; wait_comm "$tag" "$name"; }
mks() { local tag=$1 name=$2; shift 2; /usr/bin/setsid "$P/$name" "${@:-60}" & PID[$tag]=$!; wait_comm "$tag" "$name"; }
mkg() { local tag=$1 name=$2; shift 2; /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,sys; os.setpgid(0,0); os.execv(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[1:])' "$P/$name" "${@:-60}" & PID[$tag]=$!; wait_comm "$tag" "$name"; }
mkpy() { local tag=$1; shift; "$P/g1py" -c 'import time; time.sleep(60)' "$@" & PID[$tag]=$!; wait_comm "$tag" g1py; }
alive() { local t out=; for t in "$@"; do if kill -0 "${PID[$t]}" 2>/dev/null; then out+=" $t=alive"; else out+=" $t=dead"; fi; done; echo "state:$out"; }
reap() { local t; for t in "${!PID[@]}"; do [[ $t == sh ]] && continue; kill -KILL "${PID[$t]}" 2>/dev/null; wait "${PID[$t]}" 2>/dev/null; done; }

norm() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //; s/^(pgrep|pidof): //'; }

t() { echo "== $*" | mapsed; run pgrep "$@"; }
tf() { echo "== $*" | mapsed; runf pgrep "$@"; }
ts() { echo "== $*" | mapsed; shape pgrep "$@"; }

t -al g1alpha

t -d, -l g1alpha
t -d, -a g1alpha
t -d, g1beta
t -d, g1nonexistent
t -c -d, g1alpha
t -n -d, g1alpha
t --list-name g1beta
t --list-full g1beta
t --full 'g1beta 60063'
